high_level_overview.overview: This JCL job automates the compilation and deployment of a CICS COBOL program within an IBM mainframe environment. It compiles the specified COBOL source code using a predefined build procedure (BUILDONL), then issues a CICS NEWCOPY command to refresh the program in the running CICS region without requiring a restart. The job streamlines the development and deployment cycle for CICS-based business applications, ensuring the latest version of the compiled program is immediately available for transaction processing.

parameters.name: JOB
parameters.description: The accounting information or programmer name field. Here it provides a description label 'Compile CICS Program' identifying the purpose of the job to the system and operators.

parameters.name: CLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the job class (input queue) to which the job is assigned. CLASS=A routes the job to job class A, which determines scheduling priority and resource allocation based on installation-defined class definitions.

parameters.name: MSGCLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the output class for the job log (JES message log). MSGCLASS=H routes the system messages and job log to output class H, which controls where the job's log is sent (e.g., held for online viewing or printed).

parameters.name: MSGLEVEL
parameters.description: Controls the level of JCL and system messages printed in the job log. The first value (1) causes all JCL statements including those from procedures to be printed; the second value (1) causes all system messages including allocation/termination messages to be printed.

parameters.name: REGION
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum amount of memory the job is allowed to use. REGION=0M means the job can use the maximum available region size, effectively removing memory constraints on the job's execution.

parameters.name: NOTIFY
parameters.description: Specifies the TSO user ID to be notified when the job completes. &SYSUID is a system symbolic that resolves to the user ID of the person who submitted the job, so that user receives a notification message upon job completion or failure.

parameters.name: TIME
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum CPU time allowed for the entire job in minutes. TIME=1440 sets the limit to 1440 minutes (24 hours), effectively allowing the job to run without a practical CPU time restriction.

job_details.purpose: Compiles a CICS COBOL source program using the IBM Enterprise COBOL compiler with CICS preprocessing enabled. The compiled output is passed as a temporary dataset for subsequent linking.
job_details.inputs: SYSLIB: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CPY (copybook library), OEM.CICSTS.V05R06M0.CICS.SDFHCOB (CICS COBOL copy members), CEE.SCEESAMP (Language Environment samples); SYSIN: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CBL(CICSPGMN) (COBOL source member)
job_details.outputs: SYSPRINT: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LST(CICSPGMN) (compiler listing); SYSLIN: &&LOADSET (temporary object deck passed to linker); SYSUT1-SYSUT15, SYSMDECK: temporary work datasets on 3390

job_details.purpose: Copies the compiler listing dataset to SYSOUT so that the compilation output is displayed in the job log for review.
job_details.inputs: SYSUT1: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LST(CICSPGMN) (compiler listing produced in COB step)
job_details.outputs: SYSUT2: SYSOUT=* (compiler listing printed to job output); SYSPRINT: SYSOUT=*

job_details.purpose: Copies the CICS stub member DFHEILID from the CICS sample library into a temporary dataset to be included during the link-edit step.
job_details.outputs: SYSUT2: &&COPYLINK (temporary dataset, LRECL=80, BLKSIZE=400, RECFM=FB, passed to LKED step); SYSPRINT: SYSOUT=*

job_details.purpose: Link-edits the compiled COBOL object deck together with the CICS stub to produce an executable load module, using AMODE(31) and RMODE(ANY) with LIST, XREF, LET, and MAP options.
job_details.inputs: SYSLIB: OEM.CICSTS.V05R06M0.CICS.SDFHLOAD, SYS1.LINKLIB, CSF.SCSFMOD0, CEE.SCEELKED, CEE.SCEELKEX, AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB (link libraries); SYSLIN: &&LOADSET (object deck from COB step), &&COPYLINK (CICS stub from COPYLINK step)
job_details.outputs: SYSLMOD: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB(CICSPGMN) (executable load module); SYSPRINT: SYSOUT=* (link-edit map and cross-reference listing); SYSUT1: temporary work dataset on 3390

job_details.purpose: Issues a CICS CEMT SET PROG NEWCOPY command via SDSF to refresh the newly linked program in the running CICS region, making the updated load module active without requiring a CICS restart. This step executes only if the previous steps completed with a return code less than 4.
job_details.inputs: ISFIN DD *: inline command '/MODIFY CICSAWSA,\'CEMT SET PROG(CICSPGMN) NEWCOPY\'' (operator modify command targeting CICS region CICSAWSA)
job_details.outputs: ISFOUT: SYSOUT=* (SDSF output); CMDOUT: SYSOUT=* (command response output)
